rules.statement: A deed of donation is valid under Roman-Dutch law even if it does not conform to the Muslim law requirements for a gift inter vivos, provided that the donor did not intend to make an immediate gift and instead intended for the gift to take effect after their death.
rules.supporting_quote: "The effect of their Lordships' decision as I conceive it is that where it appears upon the construction of the deed as a whole that the intention of the donor is not to make an immediate gift, but a gift to take effect after his death, there is not such a gift as understood by the Muslim law, and the intention of the donor must if possible be given effect to under the general law."
